name: PTP-RL-MedCalc-Bench
description: A benchmark measuring models' ability to perform medical calculation and numerical reasoning tasks (e.g., dosage, unit conversions, clinical numeric computations) in a safe and accurate manner. Tasks require precise numeric outputs often with tolerance windows and emphasize stepwise reasoning and correctness under medical constraints.
evaluation_method: accuracy (numeric exact match or within specified tolerance)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset aimed at medical reasoning research with limited adoption so far but growing interest for safety-sensitive evaluation.
